term.name: ir_module
term.definition: A static context a unit keeps for code that reads it when it runs: an XQuery library module whose functions the unit holds (its source name and static base URI, ), or an XSLT element's (base URI, namespaces, default collation, its package's decimal formats, ), named by a function's module_number or by a STATIC_CALL or node constructor (sxml_ir_module)
